## NeMo Helix Tasks Container

This container image provides platform components needed for a deployed NeMo Helix.

### Resources

[Documentation](https://docs.nvidia.com/nemo-helix)

[NeMo Helix on GitHub](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/nemo-helix)
